scenarios.label: Grid only / no PV / no BESS
scenarios.definition: Reference demand supplied entirely by grid; used as a load-only reference.

scenarios.label: PV + grid, no BESS
scenarios.definition: PV generation offsets load; surplus is exported; deficit is imported.

scenarios.label: PV + BESS + grid
scenarios.definition: Same PV and load profiles with 500 kWh / 250 kW battery, 10–90% SOC limits and PV-surplus/180 kW import-threshold dispatch.

scenarios.label: Missing interval injection
scenarios.definition: Mutation test: remove one interval; validator must flag a timestamp gap and fail completeness.

scenarios.label: Energy balance corruption
scenarios.definition: Mutation test: add 10 kW to one interval grid import; validator must fail energy balance tolerance.

scenarios.label: SOC limit violation
scenarios.definition: Mutation test: set one SOC value to 95%; validator must flag SOC outside 10–90%.

scenarios.label: Duplicate timestamp
scenarios.definition: Mutation test: duplicate one timestamp; validator must fail uniqueness/monotonicity.
